protocol.study: Exploratory stronger-baseline replay of frozen pilot captures
protocol.selection: First8 per partition ordered by SHA256(document_id), fixed before new outcomes; same IDs across all seeds, depths and arms

published_baseline.name: SIPIT, budgeted public-checkpoint adaptation
published_baseline.implementation: Independent paper implementation; author source used externally for fidelity only
adaptations: Bound32/128 iterations per token instead of vocabulary-size ceiling
Return best verified discrete residual on exhaustion
Use actual stale/noisy captures, not recomputed targets
Squared Euclidean distances via matrix multiplication; skip final unused backward if all examples match

compute.matched: Forward and union-joint beam at identical K, beam width, documents and depth; same count of public-head prefix evaluations
measured: CUDA event elapsed time (includes host launch gaps; not pure GPU busy time)
CUDA peak and incremental allocated memory
Public-head forward calls, sequences, prefix token positions
Backward calls and prefix token positions
compute.setup: Model loading/warmup and public ridge calibration recorded separately; report applicable setup plus attack time
compute.published_comparison: Recovery versus measured compute; optimizer iterations are not matched to beam expansions

statistics.unit: Five paired seeds, conditional on fixed eight documents per mode
statistics.interval: Bonferroni-adjusted Student t, alpha .05; descriptive, not confirmatory

limits: Exploratory reuse of a previously inspected pilot; requires fresh held-out replication
Training captures include dropout and evolving private weights; inference uses final weights in eval mode
No private client checkpoint, labels, server-tail weights or dropout masks granted to attacks
Backward direction is a heuristic, not full published TAG gradient matching
Finite beam search is approximate and candidate construction is under test
SIPIT exact-recovery guarantee does not apply to noisy/stale public-checkpoint adaptation
Depth is assigned to host; no causal depth claim
Eight fixed documents and five seeds do not establish population generalization
